channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Salvador Dalí — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-27
item.description: “The only difference between me and a madman is that I'm not mad.” — Salvador Dalí

item.title: Margaret Sangster — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-26
item.description: “It isn't the thing you do, dear, it's the thing you leave undone, that gives you a bit of a heartache at the setting of the sun.” — Margaret Sangster

item.title: Mahatma Gandhi — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-25
item.description: “You must not lose faith in humanity. Humanity is an ocean; if a few drops of the ocean are dirty, the ocean does not become dirty.” — Mahatma Gandhi

item.title: Marcus Aurelius — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-24
item.description: “The universe is change; our life is what our thoughts make it.” — Marcus Aurelius

item.title: Clarice Lispector — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-23
item.description: “It is because I dive into the abyss that I am beginning to love the abyss I am made of.” — Clarice Lispector

item.title: Haruki Murakami — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-22
item.description: “Pain is inevitable. Suffering is optional.” — Haruki Murakami

item.title: Marcus Aurelius — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-21
item.description: “Each day provides its own gifts.” — Marcus Aurelius

item.title: Les Brown — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-20
item.description: “Shoot for the moon. Even if you miss, you'll land among the stars.” — Les Brown
